decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several actual speakers in the feed, ignoring the storage cases. The consideration set includes two highly-rated JBL models, a budget-friendly Raymate speaker with good specs, a 'Best Seller' rugged option from HyperGear, and a unique bamboo retro speaker from INSMY. I ultimately decided on the JBL FLIP 5 because it has an exceptional rating (4.8) from a massive number of reviews (over 68,000), making it the most reliable choice for high-quality sound and durability in a portable format.
